mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to higher discount rates, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the past 6 months signals a weakening manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the INDPRO trend signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of declining INDPRO periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1,200,000 units signal weak residential construction, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and rise in unemployment rate signals severe labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative returns: 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (INDPRO < 100 and accelerating decline), the S&P 500 underperforms due to reduced output and higher input costs, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 and INDPRO decline rate > 0.5% per month
failure_condition: In periods with INDPRO < 100 and accelerating decline, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
